facts.raw_span: A 75-year-old black woman with insulin-dependent diabetes and obesity
10-day history of pruritic lesions on her arms and legs
2–3 months of night sweats
3 weeks of right-sided headache, sinus pain, and congestion
no associated fever, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, myalgia, or arthralgia
dozens of 1–2 cm oedematous pink-red papules with a darker red-violet central zone
White blood cell count 2.7 × 10⁹/L
Elevated IgA: 8860 mg/L
Infiltrate of atypical mononuclear cells around vessels
5% CD34+ myeloblasts
Complex karyotype with chromosomal abnormalities
FISH showed deletions of 5q and 7q in 54% of bone marrow cells
